fact: The party reaches a junction with four passages heading west and a fifth route to the east.
source_quote: The party reaches a junction with four passages heading west and a fifth route to the east.
subject: junction selection

fact: Thorin uses a virtual d5 to select one of the western passages.
source_quote: Thorin uses another virtual die—this time a d5—to select one of the western passages.
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin throws a dart at a patch of water to test for properties.
source_quote: Before proceeding, he throws a dart at another patch of water.
subject: dart test

fact: Thorin's passive perception fails to detect a concealed pit trap.
source_quote: Thorin’s passive perception fails to detect a concealed pit trap.
subject: pit trap detection

fact: Thorin falls into the pit but manages to grab the edge.
source_quote: He sees the pit a moment too late and begins to fall, but succeeds in grabbing its edge.
subject: Thorin falls

fact: Thorin scrambles out of the pit with a second effort, aided by his strength.
source_quote: A second effort allows him to scramble out, aided substantially by his strength.
subject: Thorin escapes

fact: A black pudding climbs out of the pit as Thorin dusts himself off.
source_quote: As Thorin dusts himself off, a black pudding climbs out of the pit.
subject: black pudding

fact: The party jokes that the temple is offering the speed dating version of oozes, puddings, and gelatinous cubes.
source_quote: The party jokes that the temple is offering “the speed dating version of like oozes, puddings, and cubes of gelatin.”
subject: party joke

fact: Arcane knowledge connects the concentration of oozes to Juiblex, the demon lord associated with such creatures.
source_quote: Arcane knowledge connects the concentration of oozes to Juiblex, the demon lord associated with such creatures.
subject: Juiblex

fact: The group remembers that black puddings can split when hit with certain types of weapons.
source_quote: The group remembers that black puddings can split when hit with certain types of weapons.
subject: black pudding

fact: Thorin proposes retreating roughly 25 feet to draw the creature into a larger chamber.
source_quote: Thorin proposes retreating roughly 25 feet and drawing it into a larger chamber.
subject: retreat strategy

fact: The group plans to keep the pudding out of melee range and attack while withdrawing.
source_quote: His plan is to keep it out of melee range, attack while withdrawing, and avoid its corrosive attacks entirely.
subject: combat strategy

fact: The group executes the strategy and defeats the pudding without allowing it to catch them.
source_quote: The group executes the strategy successfully and defeats the pudding without allowing it to catch them.
subject: black pudding defeated

fact: The black pudding is destroyed by ranged attacks.
subject: black pudding

fact: Glabbagool consumes the remains of the black pudding.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: The pit is empty when the party later returns to it.
source_quote: When the party later returns to the pit, it is empty.
subject: pit trap

fact: Thorin elects to continue down the passage because the unexplored alternatives are equally uncertain.
source_quote: Thorin elects to continue down the passage because the unexplored alternatives are equally uncertain.
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin makes a point of searching much more carefully for additional traps after his near fall.
source_quote: After his near fall, he makes a point of searching much more carefully for additional traps.
subject: Thorin

fact: The party reaffirms that splitting the party is a bad idea.
source_quote: The party remains together, reaffirming that “It’s always a bad idea to split the party.”
subject: party cohesion
